author: Y0urm0m1
body:
(Sorry, i couldn't think up of a good title but since its about leaving and coming back threads, i changed it :p

BEFORE YOU START HATING ON ME, i am actuallly not hating the Avicus Community. In fact, i love it. Its very friendly indeed and i love hanging out on the forums but im making a small rant what has been going on the past few events.


I am soooo annoyed of those people who leave and come back. I am seriously done with it. I am extremely pissed. IF you say your going to leave, THEN KEEEP YOUR WORD. Also, if your leaving for a short period of time, no need to post it on the forums. The forums is a place for discussion, not some time to update your status or something. Sure if you do it once i guess its ok but please do not do it all the time.

Back to the people leaving, if you want to leave, leave. IT is very simple. You say "oh im leaving 100% for sure!" NEXT THING YOU KNOW, they are back in a couple of weeks or months. I am pissed at this and they come saying "I am back!!". I literally facepalm myself when they do this. IF your going to leave, THEN LEAVE. NEVER COME BACK. The worse thing is when they leave, come back, leave and come back. You guys are so indecsisive. PLEASE MAKE A DECSION IF YOUR GOING TO LEAVE OR NOT. And i feel like the ones who do leave and make a coming back post are just seeking attention or something. I don't know. In my opinion, you should only making a leaving thread if your 100% sure you are leaving. And then you got the people who claim to leave like FOR GOOD but still hang out in game or on the forums or something. Just make up your mind

And about the staff, Do not complain sensless things to them. They are simply doing their job and they work hard to do so (not only talking about the recent events but like in general and in the near future) Be thankful we have them. They are simply doing their job. Geez. However, staff i suggest to loosen up a bit. Sure, it says in the rules that we should not give updates about status or something but i think its fine to make a thread for 1st and last presteige. After all, it is their first and it is their last and i feel they should share about it c:. So maybe tone down a bit and be chill you know  :D

TL;DR Make up your minds if your leaving or not and maybe the staff can tone down a bit c:

You may agree or disagree but i am thankful to be apart in a community like Avicus. It is truly a great pleasure to be here and I am also grateful of the staff. You may never realiize it but they do tough work, dealing with reports, emails, and forum stuff. They work their butts off to keep this community fun, together, and happy so truly great thanks to you guys. I just wanted to say this because these are my thoughts right now c:
